# SDR-MCP

> Software Defined Radio MCP server — RTL-SDR spectrum, waterfall, FM audio, station databases, and GNU Radio demod sidecar.

## Key Links

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) — full reference
- [README](README.md) — quick start
- [docs/MCP_SERVER.md](docs/MCP_SERVER.md) — tool reference

## Quick Facts

- Ports: 10890 (frontend), 10891 (MCP HTTP /mcp), 10892 (web API)
- 6 portmanteau tools: sdr_device, sdr_spectrum, sdr_stations, sdr_online, sdr_gnuradio, sdr_agentic_assist
- Hardware: RTL-SDR (USB), rtl_tcp, GNU Radio Docker sidecar
